name: Elgin Power Solutions
old_description: Elgin Power Solutions specializes in the design and fabrication of custom switchgear for industrial, renewable, and utility markets.
about:
Elgin Power Solutions has operated from Beaver, West Virginia since its founding in 1977. The company began as a provider of electrical power systems and has grown over more than four decades into a manufacturer and engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) contractor for medium- and high-voltage infrastructure.

The firm designs, fabricates, and installs custom switchgear, factory-built substations, mobile substations, and high-voltage EPC projects. Its West Virginia manufacturing facility produces mobile substations and other equipment, supported by an in-house team of certified welders, electricians, transformer winders, and assemblers. Engineering staff use Autodesk software and 3D modeling to develop solutions that also include power-quality capacitors for power factor correction, voltage regulation, harmonic filtering, and surge protection, as well as explosion-proof products and field service and testing.

Elgin serves customers across the United States in battery energy storage systems (BESS), data centers, government, manufacturing, mining, oil and gas, solar, utility and electric cooperatives, and wind energy markets.

The company emphasizes its 40-year legacy, innovative engineering, uncompromising quality standards, and dedication to on-time project delivery as differentiators, positioning itself as a partner that exceeds expectations and builds lasting relationships beyond the sale.
